- memory_id "1000956" [decision]: On 2025-12-18, the Atlas team decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, because incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes.  (about: Atlas team, indexer, index)

- memory_id "1000811": On 2025-10-15, the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.  (about: Atlas team, image resizer, marketing send)
- memory_id "1000797" [decision]: As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by Cinder; ownership transferred from the Atlas team on that date.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000793" [constraint]: As of 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings Cinder, not the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000719" [decision]: The Cinder team owns the job scheduler as of 2025-09-23, when ownership transferred from the Dune team.  (about: Dune team, job scheduler, Cinder team)
- memory_id "1000715" [decision]: Ownership of the job scheduler transferred from the Dune team to the Cinder team on 2025-09-23.  (about: Dune team, job scheduler, Cinder team)
- memory_id "1000711": As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team, not the Dune team.  (about: Dune team, job scheduler, Cinder team)
- memory_id "1000702" [decision]: The Ember team handed the authentication gateway to Cinder on 2025-09-16; Cinder owns it as of that date.  (about: Cinder, Ember team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000697": On 2025-09-16, Oskar wrote the handover doc for Diego for the authentication gateway handover to Cinder.  (about: Cinder, Diego, Oskar, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000673": The Cinder team observed on 2025-09-03 that the authentication gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: authentication gateway, runtime upgrade, Cinder team)
- memory_id "1000668" [constraint]: As of 2025-09-03, the product catalog can be released on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays; the previous Mon-Thu 09:00-17:00 UTC slot no longer applies.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000666" [constraint]: As of 2025-09-03, the product catalog can be deployed on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000598": As of 2025-07-30, the Atlas team consists of Priya Raman, after Tomasz left the team to join the Dune team.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000594": On 2025-07-30, on-call for the Atlas team passed from Tomasz to Priya Raman when Tomasz moved to the Dune team.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000563": On 2025-07-17, Yuki Tanaka handed the Cinder pager to Diego on rotation day.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000554" [decision]: The Atlas team owns the billing API as of 2025-06-09, when ownership passed from the Ember team; the Boreal team was recorded by mistake and never held it.  (about: Atlas team, Boreal team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000501": On 2025-06-19, Priya Raman handed the Atlas team pager to Tomasz on rotation day.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000438" [decision]: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-05-20, when ownership passed from Cinder.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000417" [decision]: Cinder adopted trunk-based development as of 2025-05-14.  (about: Cinder)
- memory_id "1000412": The Cinder team observed on 2025-05-14 that the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder, webhook dispatcher, cache change)
- memory_id "1000378": The Cinder team reported on 2025-04-24 that feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: Cinder, feature-flags, Tuesday's deploy)
- memory_id "1000351" [decision]: The product catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table, because the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000339": The product catalog calls the image resizer for thumbnails, so the image resizer is a hard dependency of the product catalog.  (about: product catalog, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000158": The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents.  (about: product catalog, indexer)
- memory_id "1000112": Cinder owns the product catalog.  (about: Cinder, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000085": Diego is on call for Cinder to start the year.  (about: Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000021": Yuki Tanaka is on Cinder.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder)
